title.en: Confirm the channel by mining blocks

starter.cli:
# The funding transaction needs confirmations before the channel can be used.
bitcoin-cli -generate 6
sleep 3
JIFUNZE_NODE=alice lncli listchannels | jq '.channels[] | {remote_pubkey, capacity, active}'

solution.cli:
bitcoin-cli -generate 6
sleep 5
JIFUNZE_NODE=alice lncli listchannels | jq '.channels[] | {remote_pubkey, capacity, active}'
